item.title: Maná Announces Latin American Leg of Vivir Sin Aire Tour: Here Are the Dates
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update. We've got some exciting news for fans of Latin rock. The iconic Mexican band, Maná, is set to embark on a new tour, celebrating their 40th anniversary. The Vivir Sin Aire Tour will take them to stadiums across Latin America, starting on November 28th in Bogotá, Colombia, and wrapping up on December 17th in Mexico City.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "This announcement comes hot on the heels of their historic performance at the 2026 FIFA World Cup opening ceremony in Mexico City, which was watched by billions of people worldwide. The band, composed of Fher Olvera, Álex González, Sergio Vallín, and Juan Calleros, will visit cities in Peru, Chile, and Argentina, as part of this highly anticipated tour.
[Music transitions to a short clip of "Oye Mi Amor"]
Host: "Maná's music has been making waves globally, with their classic hit 'Oye Mi Amor' recently featured on Dua Lipa's new album, Live From Mexico City. The band has achieved numerous milestones, including being the first Latin band nominated for the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2025. They were also highlighted by Billboard as one of the 50 Greatest Rock Bands in Spanish of All Time.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "If you're a fan of Maná, you won't want to miss this opportunity to see them live. The Vivir Sin Aire Tour promises to be an unforgettable experience. We'll have more updates on the tour dates and venues, so stay tuned. That's all for now. Thanks for listening, and we'll catch you in the next episode."
[Outro music plays]
